title: Comparison of Structure-Preserving Methods for the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes Equations
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures, submitted as proceeding contributions ENUMATH 2025 Update v2: bug fix regarding initial data
summary: We develop structure-preserving discontinuous Galerkin methods for the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes equations with degenerate mobility. The proposed SWIPD-L and SIPGD-L methods incorporate parametrized mobility fluxes with edge-wise mobility treatments for enhanced coercivity-stability control. We prove coercivity for the generalized trilinear form and demonstrate optimal convergence rates while preserving mass conservation, energy dissipation, and the discrete maximum principle. Comparisons with existing SIPG-L and SWIP-L methods confirm similar stability. Validation on $hp$-adaptive meshes for both standalone Cahn-Hilliard and coupled systems shows significant computational savings without accuracy loss.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, submitted as proceeding contributions ENUMATH 2025 Update v2: bug fix regarding initial data

AI.title_translation: Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程的保结构方法的比较

AI.motivation: 为了开发能够处理具有退化迁移率的Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes方程的保结构方法。
AI.method: 开发了参数化迁移率通量的SWIPD-L和SIPGD-L方法，并结合了边缘迁移率处理，以增强协强性-稳定性控制。对广义三线性形式证明了协强性。

title: Lap2: Revisiting Laplace DP-SGD for High Dimensions via Majorization Theory
comments: Accepted at IEEE CSF 2026; Corrected version; 16 pages including appendix. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.06264
summary:
Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) is a cornerstone technique for ensuring privacy in deep learning, widely used in both training from scratch and fine-tuning large-scale language models. While DP-SGD predominantly relies on the Gaussian mechanism, the Laplace mechanism remains underutilized due to its reliance on L1 norm clipping. This constraint severely limits its practicality in high-dimensional models because the L1 norm of an n-dimensional gradient can be up to sqrt(n) times larger than its L2 norm. As a result, the required noise scale grows significantly with model size, leading to poor utility or untrainable models.
  In this work, we introduce Lap2, a new solution that enables L2 clipping for Laplace DP-SGD while preserving strong privacy guarantees. We overcome the dimensionality-driven clipping barrier by computing coordinate-wise moment bounds and applying majorization theory to construct a tight, data-independent upper bound over the full model. By exploiting the Schur-convexity of the moment accountant function, we aggregate these bounds using a carefully designed majorization set that respects the L2 clipping constraint. This yields a multivariate privacy accountant that scales gracefully with model dimension and enables the use of thousands of moments. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the performance of Laplace DP-SGD, achieving results comparable to or better than Gaussian DP-SGD under strong privacy constraints. For instance, fine-tuning RoBERTa-base (125M parameters) on SST-2 achieves 87.88% accuracy at epsilon=0.54, outperforming Gaussian (87.16%) and standard Laplace (48.97%) under the same budget.

AI.title_translation: Lap2: 通过优超理论重新审视高维拉普拉斯差分隐私随机梯度下降
AI.tldr: Lap2通过引入L2裁剪和利用优超理论，解决了传统拉普拉斯DP-SGD在高维模型中因L1裁剪导致的效用差问题，显著提升了其性能，甚至超越了高斯DP-SGD。
AI.motivation: 传统的差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）主要依赖高斯机制，而拉普拉斯机制因其对L1范数裁剪的依赖而在高维模型中应用受限。高维梯度L1范数可能远大于L2范数，导致所需噪声规模显著增大，从而降低模型效用或使其无法训练。
AI.method: Lap2通过计算坐标级矩界并应用优超理论，构建了对整个模型紧密且与数据无关的L2裁剪上界，从而实现了拉普拉斯DP-SGD的L2裁剪。通过利用矩核算函数（moment accountant function）的Schur-凸性，并使用精心设计的优超集聚合这些界限，构建了一个与模型维度优雅扩展的多元隐私核算器，并支持使用数千个矩。
AI.result: Lap2显著改善了拉普拉斯DP-SGD的性能，在强隐私约束下取得了与高斯DP-SGD相当或更好的结果。例如，在SST-2数据集上微调RoBERTa-base模型，在epsilon=0.54时，Lap2达到了87.88%的准确率，优于高斯机制（87.16%）和标准拉普拉斯机制（48.97%）。
AI.conclusion: Lap2成功地克服了拉普拉斯DP-SGD在高维模型中L1裁剪的限制，通过引入L2裁剪和利用优超理论，显著提高了其性能，使其在强隐私保证下与高斯DP-SGD具有竞争力甚至更优。
AI.translation:
差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）是深度学习中确保隐私的基石技术，广泛应用于从头训练和微调大规模语言模型。虽然DP-SGD主要依赖高斯机制，但拉普拉斯机制因其对L1范数裁剪的依赖而未被充分利用。这种限制严重制约了其在高维模型中的实用性，因为n维梯度的L1范数可能比其L2范数大sqrt(n)倍。结果，所需的噪声规模随模型大小显著增加，导致效用差或模型无法训练。
在这项工作中，我们引入了Lap2，这是一个新的解决方案，它使得拉普拉斯DP-SGD能够进行L2裁剪，同时保持强大的隐私保证。我们通过计算坐标级矩界并应用优超理论构建了对整个模型紧密且与数据无关的上界，从而克服了维度驱动的裁剪障碍。通过利用矩核算函数（moment accountant function）的Schur-凸性，我们使用精心设计的优超集聚合这些界限，该优超集尊重L2裁剪约束。这产生了一个与模型维度优雅扩展的多元隐私核算器，并支持使用数千个矩。经验评估表明，我们的方法显著改善了拉普拉斯DP-SGD的性能，在强隐私约束下取得了与高斯DP-SGD相当或更好的结果。例如，在SST-2上微调RoBERTa-base（1.25亿参数）在epsilon=0.54时达到了87.88%的准确率，优于高斯机制（87.16%）和标准拉普拉斯机制（48.97%）在相同预算下的表现。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Lap2，一种改进的拉普拉斯差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）方法，旨在解决传统拉普拉斯机制在高维模型中因L1范数裁剪导致的效用问题。Lap2通过引入L2裁剪、计算坐标级矩界和应用优超理论，构建了一个紧密的、与数据无关的L2裁剪上界。该方法利用矩核算函数的Schur-凸性，实现了与模型维度优雅扩展的多元隐私核算器。实验结果表明，Lap2显著提升了拉普拉斯DP-SGD的性能，在强隐私约束下表现优于或媲美高斯DP-SGD，尤其在大型语言模型微调任务中展现出卓越的准确率。

title: Interpretable Multimodal Gesture Recognition for Drone and Mobile Robot Teleoperation via Log-Likelihood Ratio Fusion
summary: Human operators are still frequently exposed to hazardous environments such as disaster zones and industrial facilities, where intuitive and reliable teleoperation of mobile robots and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is essential. In this context, hands-free teleoperation enhances operator mobility and situational awareness, thereby improving safety in hazardous environments. While vision-based gesture recognition has been explored as one method for hands-free teleoperation, its performance often deteriorates under occlusions, lighting variations, and cluttered backgrounds, limiting its applicability in real-world operations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a multimodal gesture recognition framework that integrates inertial data (accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation) from Apple Watches on both wrists with capacitive sensing signals from custom gloves. We design a late fusion strategy based on the log-likelihood ratio (LLR), which not only enhances recognition performance but also provides interpretability by quantifying modality-specific contributions. To support this research, we introduce a new dataset of 20 distinct gestures inspired by aircraft marshalling signals, comprising synchronized RGB video, IMU, and capacitive sensor data. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves performance comparable to a state-of-the-art vision-based baseline while significantly reducing computational cost, model size, and training time, making it well suited for real-time robot control. We therefore underscore the potential of sensor-based multimodal fusion as a robust and interpretable solution for gesture-driven mobile robot and drone teleoperation.

AI.title_translation: 通过对数似然比融合的可解释的多模态手势识别用于无人机和移动机器人遥操作
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种结合Apple Watch惯性数据和定制手套电容信号的多模态手势识别系统，使用LLR融合，提高了危险环境中无人机/机器人遥操作的可靠性和可解释性，且计算效率更高。
AI.motivation: 在灾害区域和工业设施等危险环境中，直观可靠的移动机器人和无人机遥操作至关重要。免提遥操作可以增强操作员的机动性和态势感知能力，但纯视觉手势识别在遮挡、光照变化和背景杂乱时性能会下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种多模态手势识别框架，整合了来自Apple Watch的手部惯性数据（加速度计、陀螺仪和方向）和来自定制手套的电容感应信号。采用基于对数似然比（LLR）的晚期融合策略来提高性能并提供可解释性。收集了一个包含20种手势的新数据集，同步了RGB视频、IMU和电容传感器数据。
AI.result: 所提出的框架实现了与最先进的基于视觉的基线相当的性能，同时显著降低了计算成本、模型大小和训练时间，使其非常适合实时机器人控制。
AI.conclusion: 基于传感器的多模态融合（特别是结合惯性数据和电容感应信号）为手势驱动的移动机器人和无人机遥操作提供了一种强大且可解释的解决方案。
AI.translation: 人类操作员仍然频繁暴露在灾区和工业设施等危险环境中，在这些环境中，移动机器人和无人机（UAV）的直观可靠的遥操作至关重要。在此背景下，免提遥操作增强了操作员的机动性和态势感知能力，从而提高了危险环境中的安全性。虽然基于视觉的手势识别已被探索作为免提遥操作的一种方法，但其性能通常在遮挡、光照变化和背景杂乱的情况下会恶化，限制了其在实际操作中的应用。为克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种多模态手势识别框架，该框架整合了来自双腕Apple Watch的惯性数据（加速度计、陀螺仪和方向）与来自定制手套的电容感应信号。我们设计了一种基于对数似然比（LLR）的晚期融合策略，该策略不仅提高了识别性能，还通过量化模态特定的贡献提供了可解释性。为支持这项研究，我们引入了一个新的数据集，其中包含20种受飞机引导信号启发的不同手势，包括同步的RGB视频、IMU和电容传感器数据。实验结果表明，我们的框架实现了与最先进的基于视觉的基线相当的性能，同时显著降低了计算成本、模型大小和训练时间，使其非常适合实时机器人控制。因此，我们强调了基于传感器的多模态融合作为手势驱动的移动机器人和无人机遥操作的鲁棒且可解释的解决方案的潜力。
AI.summary: 为了克服纯视觉手势识别在复杂环境中的局限性，本研究提出了一种多模态手势识别框架，通过融合Apple Watch的惯性数据和定制手套的电容感应信号，并采用基于对数似然比（LLR）的晚期融合策略。该方法不仅提高了识别性能，还提供了可解释性，并且在实验中展示了与视觉基线相当的性能，同时具有更低的计算开销。
AI.keywords: 多模态融合, 手势识别, 机器人遥操作, 对数似然比, 无人机
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一种基于对数似然比（LLR）的晚期融合策略，它不仅提高了识别性能，还通过量化模态贡献提供了可解释性。该方法通过结合惯性数据和电容感应信号，有效克服了纯视觉方法的局限性。其重要性在于为危险环境下的机器人遥操作提供了一种鲁棒且计算效率高的替代方案。局限性在于其性能在未在摘要中明确说明，但其对特定传感器（Apple Watch和定制手套）的依赖可能是一个限制。

title: Diffusion Probe: Generated Image Result Prediction Using CNN Probes
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models lack an efficient mechanism for early quality assessment, leading to costly trial-and-error in multi-generation scenarios such as prompt iteration, agent-based generation, and flow-grpo. We reveal a strong correlation between early diffusion cross-attention distributions and final image quality. Based on this finding, we introduce Diffusion Probe, a framework that leverages internal cross-attention maps as predictive signals. We design a lightweight predictor that maps statistical properties of early-stage cross-attention extracted from initial denoising steps to the final image's overall quality. This enables accurate forecasting of image quality across diverse evaluation metrics long before full synthesis is complete. We validate Diffusion Probe across a wide range of settings. On multiple T2I models, across early denoising windows, resolutions, and quality metrics, it achieves strong correlation (PCC > 0.7) and high classification performance (AUC-ROC > 0.9). Its reliability translates into practical gains. By enabling early quality-aware decisions in workflows such as prompt optimization, seed selection, and accelerated RL training, the probe supports more targeted sampling and avoids computation on low-potential generations. This reduces computational overhead while improving final output quality.Diffusion Probe is model-agnostic, efficient, and broadly applicable, offering a practical solution for improving T2I generation efficiency through early quality prediction.

AI.title_translation: 扩散探测器：使用CNN探测器预测生成图像结果
AI.tldr: 扩散探测器利用早期扩散模型的交叉注意力分布来预测文本到图像生成结果的最终质量，从而提高效率并减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型缺乏有效的早期质量评估机制，导致在多代生成场景（如提示迭代、基于代理的生成和流式生成）中进行耗时的试错。
AI.method: 该研究揭示了早期扩散交叉注意力分布与最终图像质量之间的强相关性。在此基础上，引入了Diffusion Probe框架，该框架利用内部交叉注意力图作为预测信号。设计了一个轻量级预测器，将从初始去噪步骤中提取的早期交叉注意力统计特性映射到最终图像的整体质量。
AI.result: 在多种T2I模型、早期去噪窗口、分辨率和质量指标上，Diffusion Probe实现了强相关性（PCC > 0.7）和高分类性能（AUC-ROC > 0.9）。其可靠性转化为实际收益，通过在提示优化、种子选择和加速RL训练等工作流程中实现早期质量感知决策，支持更有针对性的采样，避免对低潜力生成进行计算，从而降低计算开销并提高最终输出质量。
AI.conclusion: Diffusion Probe是一种模型无关、高效且广泛适用的解决方案，通过早期质量预测提高了T2I生成效率。

title: Pessimistic Auxiliary Policy for Offline Reinforcement Learning
comments: Withdrawn due to a crucial mistake
summary: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn an agent from pre-collected datasets, avoiding unsafe and inefficient real-time interaction. However, inevitable access to out-ofdistribution actions during the learning process introduces approximation errors, causing the error accumulation and considerable overestimation. In this paper, we construct a new pessimistic auxiliary policy for sampling reliable actions. Specifically, we develop a pessimistic auxiliary strategy by maximizing the lower confidence bound of the Q-function. The pessimistic auxiliary strategy exhibits a relatively high value and low uncertainty in the vicinity of the learned policy, avoiding the learned policy sampling high-value actions with potentially high errors during the learning process. Less approximation error introduced by sampled action from pessimistic auxiliary strategy leads to the alleviation of error accumulation. Extensive experiments on offline reinforcement learning benchmarks reveal that utilizing the pessimistic auxiliary strategy can effectively improve the efficacy of other offline RL approaches.

AI.title_translation: 离线强化学习中的悲观辅助策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种悲观辅助策略，通过最大化Q函数的下置信界来采样可靠动作，从而减少离线强化学习中的近似误差和误差累积，有效提升现有离线RL方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习中，学习过程中不可避免地会接触到分布外动作，这会引入近似误差，导致误差累积和显著的过高估计。

AI.result: 在离线强化学习基准上的大量实验表明，利用悲观辅助策略可以有效提高其他离线RL方法的效率。

title: Jailbreak Foundry: From Papers to Runnable Attacks for Reproducible Benchmarking
summary: Jailbreak techniques for large language models (LLMs) evolve faster than benchmarks, making robustness estimates stale and difficult to compare across papers due to drift in datasets, harnesses, and judging protocols. We introduce JAILBREAK FOUNDRY (JBF), a system that addresses this gap via a multi-agent workflow to translate jailbreak papers into executable modules for immediate evaluation within a unified harness. JBF features three core components: (i) JBF-LIB for shared contracts and reusable utilities; (ii) JBF-FORGE for the multi-agent paper-to-module translation; and (iii) JBF-EVAL for standardizing evaluations. Across 30 reproduced attacks, JBF achieves high fidelity with a mean (reproduced-reported) attack success rate (ASR) deviation of +0.26 percentage points. By leveraging shared infrastructure, JBF reduces attack-specific implementation code by nearly half relative to original repositories and achieves an 82.5% mean reused-code ratio. This system enables a standardized AdvBench evaluation of all 30 attacks across 10 victim models using a consistent GPT-4o judge. By automating both attack integration and standardized evaluation, JBF offers a scalable solution for creating living benchmarks that keep pace with the rapidly shifting security landscape.

AI.title_translation: 越狱铸造厂：从论文到可运行攻击，实现可复现的基准测试
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的越狱技术发展迅速，但基准测试却滞后。Jailbreak Foundry (JBF) 系统通过多智能体工作流将越狱论文转化为可执行攻击，以实现统一、可复现的基准测试，从而解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的越狱技术发展速度快于基准测试，导致鲁棒性评估过时，并且由于数据集、工具和判断协议的差异，使得不同论文之间的比较变得困难。
AI.method: JBF系统通过多智能体工作流将越狱论文转化为可执行模块，并在统一框架内进行即时评估。它包含三个核心组件：(i) JBF-LIB 用于共享契约和可重用工具；(ii) JBF-FORGE 用于多智能体论文到模块的转换；(iii) JBF-EVAL 用于标准化评估。
AI.result: 在30次复现攻击中，JBF实现了高保真度，平均（复现-报告）攻击成功率（ASR）偏差为+0.26个百分点。通过利用共享基础设施，JBF将攻击特定实现代码量比原始存储库减少了近一半，并实现了82.5%的平均重用代码率。该系统能够使用一致的GPT-4o评判员，对10个受害模型上的所有30次攻击进行标准化AdvBench评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动化攻击集成和标准化评估，JBF提供了一个可扩展的解决方案，用于创建能够跟上快速变化的安全格局的动态基准。

title: DiffusionHarmonizer: Bridging Neural Reconstruction and Photorealistic Simulation with Online Diffusion Enhancer
comments: For more details and updates, please visit our project website: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/diffusion-harmonizer
summary: Simulation is essential to the development and evaluation of autonomous robots such as self-driving vehicles. Neural reconstruction is emerging as a promising solution as it enables simulating a wide variety of scenarios from real-world data alone in an automated and scalable way. However, while methods such as NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting can produce visually compelling results, they often exhibit artifacts particularly when rendering novel views, and fail to realistically integrate inserted dynamic objects, especially when they were captured from different scenes. To overcome these limitations, we introduce DiffusionHarmonizer, an online generative enhancement framework that transforms renderings from such imperfect scenes into temporally consistent outputs while improving their realism. At its core is a single-step temporally-conditioned enhancer that is converted from a pretrained multi-step image diffusion model, capable of running in online simulators on a single GPU. The key to training it effectively is a custom data curation pipeline that constructs synthetic-real pairs emphasizing appearance harmonization, artifact correction, and lighting realism. The result is a scalable system that significantly elevates simulation fidelity in both research and production environments.

AI.title_translation: DiffusionHarmonizer：使用在线扩散增强器弥合神经重建与逼真模拟之间的鸿沟
AI.tldr: DiffusionHarmonizer 是一个快速的在线框架，它将 NeRF/3DGS 等神经重建技术渲染出的有瑕疵的模拟场景，通过一个特制的、基于扩散模型的增强器，实时修复并转化为高保真的、时间一致的逼真模拟结果。

AI.method: 核心是一个单步、时序条件化的增强器，该增强器由预训练的多步图像扩散模型转换而来，能够在单张GPU上在线运行。训练的关键在于一个定制的数据策展管道，用于构建强调外观协调、伪影校正和光照真实性的合成-真实数据对。
AI.result: 一个可扩展的系统，显著提高了研究和生产环境中的仿真保真度。
AI.conclusion: DiffusionHarmonizer 是一个可扩展的系统，它显著提高了研究和生产环境中的仿真保真度。
AI.translation: 仿真对于自动驾驶等自主机器人的开发和评估至关重要。神经重建作为一种有前途的解决方案正在兴起，因为它能够以自动化和可扩展的方式仅从真实世界数据中模拟各种场景。然而，虽然像 NeRF 和 3D Gaussian Splatting 这样的方法可以产生视觉上引人注目的结果，但它们在渲染新视图时经常出现伪影，并且难以真实地集成插入的动态对象，特别是当它们是从不同场景捕获时。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了 DiffusionHarmonizer，一个在线生成增强框架，它将来自这些不完美场景的渲染转换为时间一致的输出，同时提高其真实感。其核心是一个由预训练的多步图像扩散模型转换而来的单步时序条件化增强器，能够在单张 GPU 上的在线模拟器中运行。有效训练的关键在于一个定制的数据策展管道，该管道构建了强调外观协调、伪影校正和光照真实性的合成-真实数据对。最终结果是一个可扩展的系统，在研究和生产环境中都显著提升了仿真保真度。
AI.summary: 为解决神经重建渲染（如 NeRF/3DGS）中存在的伪影和动态对象集成不真实的问题，本文提出了 DiffusionHarmonizer 框架。该框架利用一个单步、时序条件化的扩散增强器，通过定制的数据策展管道进行训练，实现了从不完美渲染到时间一致且逼真的输出的在线转换，从而显著提升了仿真保真度。
AI.keywords: 神经重建, 仿真, 扩散模型, 实时增强, 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个在线的、单步的、时序条件化的增强框架（DiffusionHarmonizer），有效地解决了神经重建渲染中常见的伪影和动态物体集成不真实的问题。其重要性在于提升了基于真实世界数据训练的神经渲染在自动驾驶等领域的仿真保真度。局限性可能在于其性能高度依赖于训练阶段构建的“合成-真实”数据对的质量。

title: UFO-4D: Unposed Feedforward 4D Reconstruction from Two Images
summary: Dense 4D reconstruction from unposed images remains a critical challenge, with current methods relying on slow test-time optimization or fragmented, task-specific feedforward models. We introduce UFO-4D, a unified feedforward framework to reconstruct a dense, explicit 4D representation from just a pair of unposed images. UFO-4D directly estimates dynamic 3D Gaussian Splats, enabling the joint and consistent estimation of 3D geometry, 3D motion, and camera pose in a feedforward manner. Our core insight is that differentiably rendering multiple signals from a single Dynamic 3D Gaussian representation offers major training advantages. This approach enables a self-supervised image synthesis loss while tightly coupling appearance, depth, and motion. Since all modalities share the same geometric primitives, supervising one inherently regularizes and improves the others. This synergy overcomes data scarcity, allowing UFO-4D to outperform prior work by up to 3 times in joint geometry, motion, and camera pose estimation. Our representation also enables high-fidelity 4D interpolation across novel views and time. Please visit our project page for visual results: https://ufo-4d.github.io/

AI.title_translation: UFO-4D：从两张图像进行无姿态前馈4D重建
AI.tldr: UFO-4D是一个前馈框架，能从两张无姿态图像中直接重建动态4D场景（使用3D高斯泼溅），它通过统一建模几何、运动和姿态，并在自监督下训练，性能比现有方法快3倍。
AI.motivation: 从无姿态图像进行密集4D重建是一个关键挑战，现有方法依赖于缓慢的测试时间优化或零碎、特定任务的前馈模型。
AI.method: UFO-4D是一个统一的前馈框架，直接估计动态3D高斯泼溅（Dynamic 3D Gaussians），以实现从两张无姿态图像中对3D几何、3D运动和相机姿态的联合和一致估计。其核心是可微分渲染来自单一动态3D高斯表示的多种信号，以实现自监督图像合成损失，并紧密耦合外观、深度和运动。
AI.result: UFO-4D在联合几何、运动和相机姿态估计方面，性能优于先前工作高达3倍。
AI.conclusion: UFO-4D的表示方法实现了高保真度的视角和时间插值。
AI.translation: 从无姿态图像进行密集4D重建仍然是一个关键挑战，现有方法依赖于缓慢的测试时间优化或零碎、特定任务的前馈模型。我们引入了UFO-4D，一个统一的前馈框架，用于仅从一对无姿态图像中重建密集的、显式的4D表示。UFO-4D直接估计动态3D高斯泼溅，从而能够以前馈方式联合和一致地估计3D几何、3D运动和相机姿态。我们的核心见解是，从单个动态3D高斯表示中可微分渲染多种信号，可以带来主要的训练优势。这种方法实现了自监督图像合成损失，同时紧密耦合了外观、深度和运动。由于所有模态共享相同的几何基元，监督其中一个自然地正则化并改进了其他模态。这种协同作用克服了数据稀缺性，使UFO-4D在联合几何、运动和相机姿态估计方面优于先前工作高达3倍。我们的表示还支持新颖视角和时间上的高保真4D插值。请访问我们的项目页面查看视觉结果：https://ufo-4d.github.io/
AI.summary: UFO-4D是一个新颖的、统一的前馈框架，旨在从仅有的两张未标定（unposed）图像中重建密集的、显式的4D表示。它通过直接估计动态3D高斯泼溅，实现了3D几何、3D运动和相机姿态的联合、一致的前馈估计。该方法利用单一表示的可微分渲染来增强训练，通过自监督图像合成损失紧密耦合多模态信息，显著提高了性能并支持高保真度的时空插值。

title: Dr. Seg: Revisiting GRPO Training for Visual Large Language Models through Perception-Oriented Design
summary: Following the success of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in foundation LLMs, an increasing number of works have sought to adapt GRPO to Visual Large Language Models (VLLMs) for visual perception tasks (e.g., detection and segmentation). However, much of this line of research rests on a long-standing yet unexamined assumption: training paradigms developed for language reasoning can be transferred seamlessly to visual perception. Our experiments show that this assumption is not valid, revealing intrinsic differences between reasoning-oriented and perception-oriented settings. Using reasoning segmentation as a representative case, we surface two overlooked factors: (i) the need for a broader output space, and (ii) the importance of fine-grained, stable rewards. Building on these observations, we propose Dr.~Seg, a simple, plug-and-play GRPO-based framework consisting of a Look-to-Confirm mechanism and a Distribution-Ranked Reward module, requiring no architectural modifications and integrating seamlessly with existing GRPO-based VLLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Dr.~Seg improves performance in complex visual scenarios while maintaining strong generalization. Code, models, and datasets are available at https://github.com/eVI-group-SCU/Dr-Seg.

AI.title_translation: Dr. Seg：通过感知导向设计重新审视用于视觉大模型的 GRPO 训练
AI.tldr: 论文发现直接套用语言推理场景的 GRPO 到视觉感知任务并不合适，提出无结构改动的 Dr. Seg 框架，通过扩大输出空间和精细稳定的奖励设计，显著提升视觉大模型的推理分割性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将最初为语言推理设计的 GRPO 直接迁移到视觉感知任务（如检测、分割），普遍假设训练范式可以无缝通用，但作者的实验发现这一假设不成立，理由在于推理导向与感知导向之间存在内在差异，尤其在输出空间设计和奖励信号方面，这促使作者重新设计适配视觉感知的 GRPO 训练框架。
AI.method: 以“推理分割”任务为代表场景，作者分析 VLLM 在感知任务中的训练需求，指出需要更广的输出空间和更细粒度、稳定的奖励。基于此提出 Dr. Seg：一个基于 GRPO 的简单、即插即用训练框架，包括（1）Look-to-Confirm 机制，用于在推理／观察过程中确认视觉信息，从而改善输出空间利用；（2）Distribution-Ranked Reward 模块，通过对输出分布进行排序打分来构造细致、稳定的奖励信号。该框架不改动模型架构，可无缝集成到现有基于 GRPO 的视觉大模型中。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，在复杂视觉场景下，Dr. Seg 能显著提升基于 GRPO 的 VLLM 在推理分割等感知任务上的性能，同时保持良好的泛化能力。具体定量指标、对比方法和数据集细节在摘要中未给出。
AI.conclusion: 语言推理场景下形成的 GRPO 训练范式不能直接迁移到视觉感知任务，视觉感知需要更宽的输出空间与更精细、稳定的奖励设计。Dr. Seg 通过 Look-to-Confirm 机制和 Distribution-Ranked Reward 模块，在无需改动模型结构的前提下，为 GRPO 训练的 VLLM 提供了更适配感知任务的训练方式，在复杂视觉场景中带来性能与泛化的双重提升。
